{{Top}}
'''Neskroff''' was a city on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Isis/Legends|Isis]]. It was colonized prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] by anti-[[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] proponents under [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa's]] leadership, and was the planet's only [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]].
